title: Books to be kept by insurers established outside India.
text:
64. Books to be kept by insurers established outside India. —Every insurer, having his principal

place of business or domicile outside [India], shall keep at his principal office in [India]. such books of
account, registers and documents as will enable the accounts, statements and abstracts which he is
required under this Act to furnish to the [Authority] in respect of the insurance business transacted by
him, in India to be compiled and, if necessary, checked by the [Authority] [and shall furnish to
